name: Lab: 24-2 (42 points), no eye tracker (blind-spot check), 51 cm
description: Same grid and distance, for when the eye tracker is not available: fixation is checked with patches at each person's own blind spot (found at the start). Not reliable for the eye whose blind spot falls in a blind half of the field. No dithering: the faintest patch is one grey step and the seeds start in the middle of the range, both from the photometer (Lab screen: 0.1 to 32.9 dB, start 16.5 dB).
